definitions.explanation: Something made to imitate or resemble the genuine article, typically with intent to deceive.

examples.japanese: これは{偽|にせ}のブランド{品|ひん}だ。
examples.english: This is a counterfeit brand-name product.

examples.japanese: {偽|にせ}{札|さつ}が{見|み}つかった。
{本物|ほんもの}か{偽|にせ}かを{見分|みわ}けるのは{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: It's difficult to tell the real from the fake.

notes:
{偽|にせ} means "fake" or "counterfeit" and functions both as a standalone noun and as a prefix that attaches to other nouns to indicate something is not genuine.

COMPOUNDS:
- {偽|にせ}もの: fake item, counterfeit
- {偽|にせ}{札|さつ}: counterfeit money/bills
- {偽|にせ}{名|な}: false name, alias
- {偽|にせ}{医者|いしゃ}: fake doctor, quack
- {偽|にせ}{情報|じょうほう}: false information

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {偽物|にせもの}: counterfeit, imitation (the noun form)
- {贋作|がんさく}: forgery (specifically of art or antiques)
- フェイク: fake (loanword, common in fashion and media)
- {模造品|もぞうひん}: imitation product (neutral; focuses on the copying)
{本物|ほんもの} (the real thing, genuine article) is the opposite of {偽物|にせもの}. The pattern {本物|ほんもの}か{偽物|にせもの}か (real or fake?) is very common.
